# Scope of the Showcase A findings

*Generated by `make scope`. 100 combinations of functional form (5 credibility × 5 saturating × 4 convex-cost members) × 24 parameter settings.*

Each family is specified by the qualitative properties a theory asserts, and its
members are endpoint-normalised — so what varies below is **shape**, not scale.
A claim that survives the whole family is a claim about the theory. One that
survives a single member is a claim about our arithmetic.

Three questions are kept apart, because a finding can be robust to one and
fragile to the other. **Forms @ centre** varies the shape at the parameter
setting the figures were produced at. **Params @ default** varies the setting
at the shape they were produced with. **Joint** is the whole grid.

| Finding | Forms @ centre | Params @ default | Joint |
|---|---|---|---|
| **mb_single_peaked**<br/><sub>MB rises then falls and never turns back up.</sub> | 90% | **all** | 94% |
| **interior_optimum**<br/><sub>Total additional value is maximal at an interior π.</sub> | **all** | **all** | **all** |
| **mb_starts_at_origin**<br/><sub>Purpose returns nothing until it is believed: MB(0) ≈ 0.</sub> | 74% | **all** | 76% |
| **channels_non_negative**<br/><sub>Both rights channels carry non-negative value up to the optimum.</sub> | 73% | **all** | 68% |
| **residual_exhausted_first**<br/><sub>The control boundary meets MB before the optimum, exhausting the residual channel.</sub> | **all** | **all** | **all** |
| **soft_governance_raises_B**<br/><sub>Sheet 2a: AI-enabled contractibility raises the control channel.</sub> | **all** | 75% | 68% |
| **soft_governance_substitutes**<br/><sub>Sheet 2a, stronger: what B gains, A gives up — relocation, not creation.</sub> | **all** | 75% | 68% |
| **principal_costs_spare_B**<br/><sub>Sheet 2b: principal costs fall on the residual channel and leave B untouched.</sub> | **all** | **all** | **all** |
| **agency_costs_hit_both**<br/><sub>Sheet 3: agency costs compress both channels.</sub> | **all** | **all** | **all** |

## What the failures are attributable to

Marginal hold-rate per family member: the shape responsible shows up as a
low rate in its own column while the others stay flat.

### mb_single_peaked

94% overall; **form-dependent**.

- `credibility`: logistic_late 88%, logistic 90%, smoothstep 90%, smootherstep 100%, algebraic 100%
- `saturating`: cbrt 69%, sqrt 99%, exponential 100%, log 100%, hyperbolic 100%
- `convex_cost`: quadratic 93%, cubic 94%, exponential 94%, quartic 94%

First failure: `logistic/cbrt/quadratic` at alpha=0.2, principal_competence=0.7, principal_conflict=0.3, agent_conflict=0.3.

### mb_starts_at_origin

76% overall; **form-dependent**.

- `credibility`: logistic_late 61%, logistic 62%, smoothstep 69%, smootherstep 88%, algebraic 97%
- `saturating`: cbrt 27%, sqrt 52%, log 99%, exponential 100%, hyperbolic 100% ←
- `convex_cost`: quadratic 72%, cubic 74%, quartic 75%, exponential 82%

First failure: `logistic/sqrt/quadratic` at alpha=0.2, principal_competence=0.7, principal_conflict=0.3, agent_conflict=0.3.

### channels_non_negative

68% overall; **form-dependent**.

- `credibility`: algebraic 47%, smootherstep 61%, logistic_late 71%, smoothstep 79%, logistic 81% ←
- `saturating`: hyperbolic 60%, exponential 61%, log 61%, sqrt 73%, cbrt 84%
- `convex_cost`: exponential 14%, quadratic 62%, cubic 95%, quartic 100% ←

First failure: `logistic/exponential/exponential` at alpha=0.2, principal_competence=0.7, principal_conflict=0.3, agent_conflict=0.3.

### soft_governance_raises_B

68% overall; **parameter-dependent — every shape agrees at the reported setting**.

- `credibility`: logistic_late 64%, smoothstep 65%, smootherstep 68%, algebraic 69%, logistic 75%
- `saturating`: cbrt 67%, exponential 67%, sqrt 69%, log 69%, hyperbolic 69%
- `convex_cost`: quadratic 66%, exponential 66%, cubic 70%, quartic 72%

First failure: `logistic/exponential/quadratic` at alpha=0.929, principal_competence=0.092, principal_conflict=0.823, agent_conflict=0.311.
